source_note: This is not a trained neural cellular automaton. It is a small discrete local-attractor lab to test whether CA/NCA-style growth and repair metrics are useful after lifecycle metrics exist.

decision.reason: The discrete local-attractor repair improves damaged grids and preserves lifecycle viability, but it is not a trained NCA and should remain a repair/growth lab until visual ratings and harder damage tests exist.

limitations: No differentiable training loop is used in Stage 0.
The attractor uses a target grid as a genotype-like template.
Damage patterns are deterministic and small.
Human perception of growth and repair is not rated yet.
